lines.zh: 我一节一节地爬过叶子。
lines.en: I crawl across the leaf, segment by segment.
I walk only on leaves.

lines.zh: 我一伸一缩，爬过一道叶脉。
lines.en: I inch my way across a leaf vein.
I move along the leaf's vein.
The leaf's edge is a little slick.

lines.zh: 我扭头看看下一片叶子。
lines.en: I look across to the next leaf.
I grip the leaf's tip with my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我身上已经有一点颜色了。
lines.en: A little color is already on me.
I turn around a vein.

lines.zh: 叶肉只剩脉络，我该换片了。
lines.en: Only veins remain; I should change leaves.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方都有缺口。
lines.en: I leave a bitten line behind me.
I move to the leaf's underside.
The ground is far too far.
I advance by stretching and bunching.
The leaf sways; I stop.
I follow the twig to fresh leaves.
I lie along a vein, still.
I am slowly growing.

lines.zh: 叶片挡住了太阳，很舒服。
lines.en: The leaf shades me. Comfortable.
I am saving strength to shed.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候像一小段枝。
lines.en: Still, I look like a twig.
Two days of leaf left here.
Safer on the underside.
Footsteps below.

lines.zh: 我身上的条纹还没显出来。
lines.en: My stripes have not shown yet.
I wait for the next molt.
In wind, I grip hard.
I am high up. Do not shake the tree.
Look up. Can you see me?
I am on this leaf.

lines.zh: 我这一身彩，全在叶上养出来。
lines.en: All this color grew on a leaf.
I must not leave the leaves yet.

lines.zh: 你手上的网，是抓成虫的吧。
lines.en: That net is for the adults, is it not?
I eat leaves and nothing else.
You smell of bark.
I crawl slowly. No need to hurry.
Do not touch. My skin is thin.
My tree is the one you are under.

lines.zh: 我把身子卷紧，贴住叶面。
lines.en: I curl tight against the leaf.

lines.zh: 背上破了一点，渗出绿汁。
lines.en: A spot on my back splits and green juice seeps out.
A little green ooze comes out.
I dropped to the underside.
It hurts. I keep still.

lines.zh: 我的脚全抓住叶脉，没松。
lines.en: All my feet grip the vein and hold.
I pulled in a segment.
You dented one segment.
That slowed my growing.
I hide behind the leaf stalk.
Leaves! That I want.
That is fruit. I do not eat it.
Is that leaf still fresh?
Put it on this branch beside me.

lines.zh: 这片叶子太老了，咬不动。
lines.en: That leaf is too old to chew.
Not flowers. Only leaves.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放地上，我就够不着。
lines.en: On the ground, I cannot reach it.
The edge of a young leaf is best.
Do not shake the tree. I would fall.
That one lasts me a day.

lines.zh: 你碰到叶子，我滚了一下。
lines.en: You touched the leaf; I rolled.
I held the vein and did not fall.
Do not shake. I really will fall.

lines.zh: 你的手指比叶子大太多。
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than the leaf.

lines.zh: 我身上一环一色，别数了。
lines.en: One colour per ring — stop counting.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，叶子破了个洞。
lines.en: After the bump, a hole in the leaf.
I moved to the underside.
Your finger shifts and the leaf sways.
So light you barely touched me.
Do not flick me to the ground.
Not yet. I must grow first.
Only the adults think of that.
My work is leaves, then a chrysalis.
Odd question for a caterpillar.
Let me molt a few more times.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，我的同伴很多。
lines.en: Many of my kind in this wood.

lines.zh: 结蛹的时候，我会安静下来。
lines.en: When I pupate, I go quiet.

lines.zh: 那时我会变成别的样子。
lines.en: Then I will look different.
Do not interrupt my eating.

lines.zh: 我现在的任务只有一件。
lines.en: I have only one task now.
I clamp onto this leaf.
Your net is caught on a branch.
Leaves on the ground are out of reach.

lines.zh: 我挪到一片新的嫩叶上。
lines.en: I move onto a fresh young leaf.
I hold the leaf's edge with forelegs.
That peel is not for me.
I push the eggshell aside.

lines.zh: 你捡起来的东西，放远些。
lines.en: Set what you picked farther away.
Too slow to carry anything heavy.
That leaf is mine. Do not take it.
I see a fresh leaf.
I start crawling.
Your hand comes; I curl up.
I have the next leaf marked.

lines.zh: 这条路只有叶脉那么宽。
lines.en: The path is only a vein wide.
I move toward the tip.
Do not block the branch.
I stretch toward it.

lines.zh: 这一口，我要咬在嫩边上。
lines.en: I will bite the tender edge.
Feeding begins now.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉一点点过去。
lines.en: I follow the vein, inch by inch.
Shake all you like. I hold.

lines.zh: 我离那片叶子还有两寸。
lines.en: Two inches to that leaf.
The leaf moves. I do not.
I anchor myself with silk.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我停住。
lines.en: When you watch, I freeze.
I turn to avoid the gap.

lines.zh: 这一片吃完，就换下一片。
lines.en: Finish this one, then the next.
My foreleg reaches the edge.

lines.zh: 叶边就在前面，我再挪一寸。
lines.en: The leaf edge is close; I inch forward.
I bite your finger.
Light, but it itches.
I rear up to look spiny.
I flick my body onto your hand.

lines.zh: 你把我弹开，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: You flick me; I roll half a turn.
My bristles catch between fingers.
Pine needles sting; so do I.
I cannot chew you, but I bite.
I twist and slip.
Do not squeeze. I will spit green.
One more egg on this leaf.
The eggshell splits and I poke my head out first.

lines.zh: 叶背很安全，我就孵在这。
lines.en: Safe underside. I hatched here.
My first move is to find a leaf.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着卵的湿气。
lines.en: I am still damp from the egg.
I poke my head out to the light.
I unfold along the vein.
One more caterpillar in the wood.
The leaf dips slightly.

lines.zh: 我开始了，从咬第一口起。
lines.en: I begin with the first bite.
Fire dries out my skin.
The leaf tilted and I dropped to the soil.
In water I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶子上掀走。
lines.en: The blast knocks me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 一支箭把叶子穿了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through the leaf.
Magic bleaches my colors.
Off the leaves, I do not last.

lines.zh: 雷光透过叶子照到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning shows through the leaf.
No leaf below. Only nothing.
